claim: Verification that lands adjacent to the artifact is not verification. Checking that a path resolves, simulating a payload, or exercising the repo copy of a script all pass while the shipped thing is broken — the Codex L4 gap survived a full spec close because the bundle shipped tracker-context.sh and nobody asserted on the hook's stdout. Run the artifact you shipped, from where it ships.
author: standalone:f224f7b9

claim: A fixture can agree with the bug. smoke-gol-315 passed against a dead leastLoadedRoleSession(rows,'manager') lookup because the fixture seeded sessions with role 'manager' too; three other fixtures passed on nothing (too small to exceed a budget, a SQL-escaped backslash-n that was two characters, a missing projects.json so the section under test never existed). Before asserting a thing survives, assert it is present, then mutate the code and watch the test fail.
author: standalone:f224f7b9

claim: Fixing the file a reviewer cited is not fixing the fact. The builder-merge rule, the role rename, and the L3 location each survived a 'fix' in one file while the same claim lived on in two or three others — lead/SKILL.md, create-ticket-drawer.jsx, mcp/channel/index.js. Grep the claim across substrate, dashboard server AND web, mcp, and tests before calling it resolved; docs are directory-granular so grep ancestors, not the changed file paths.
author: standalone:f224f7b9

claim: Repointing a dead reference is not the same as restoring the design it pointed at. When summary.jsonl turned out to have no writer, the fix repointed L3 at the central hook journal — which silently deleted three spec'd properties (repo-owned so a non-golem colleague can read it, an evidence field, a promote/discard/keep sweep). When a pointer is dead, ask what it was pointing at and why, not where else to point.
author: standalone:f224f7b9

claim: git add -A swept a background reviewer's in-flight edit into a commit and silently reverted a fix; it passed every gate because that fix was unguarded. One-writer-per-checkout includes agents a session spawns into its own tree. Stage explicitly.
